name: agent-factory-companion
description: Provides a portable Hook bootstrap that delegates Codex lifecycle events to a workspace-owned Agent Factory adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Portable bootstrap for the workspace-owned Agent Factory Hook adapter.
interface.longDescription: Delegates Codex CLI and IDE lifecycle events to the workspace adapter. It is safe alongside a project Hook because the bridge deduplicates repeated session and turn observations.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the Agent Factory context queued for this Codex session.
